serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Cloud platform for aggregating, visualizing, and analyzing test, telemetry, and mission data for hardware and complex systems, operated for U.S. Government customers in a FedRAMP-scoped, government-only AWS GovCloud (US) environment.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Nominal Trust Center: FedRAMP 20x Certification Data (Certification Package Overview, Security Decision Record, Vulnerability Detail and Accepted Vulnerability reports, Significant Change Notifications, Secure Configuration Guide), policies and assessment reports.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Request access at https://trust.nominal.io (name, email, organization and reason). Questions: fedramp-security@nominal.io.
